PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of the

Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control

of Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas) (Amendment)

Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 25 May 2021.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) Regulations 2021 [P.U. (A) 225/2021], which are referred to as the

"principal Regulations" in these Regulations, are amended by substituting for the

First Schedule the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Regulation 3]

ZONE IN THE STATE OF SARAWAK

1. Kuching Zone: Kuching District and Samarahan Division

2. Lundu Zone: Lundu District

3. Bau Zone: Bau District

4. Serian Zone: Serian Division

5. Sri Aman Zone: Sri Aman Division

6. Sarikei Zone: Sarikei Division

7. Betong Zone: Betong Division

8. Mukah Zone: Mukah Division

9. Bintulu Zone: Bintulu Division

10. Miri Zone: Miri District

11. Beluru Zone: Beluru District

12. Subis Zone: Subis District

13. Telang Usan Zone: Telang Usan District

14. Marudi Zone: Marudi District

15. Limbang Zone: Limbang Division

16. Sibu Zone: Sibu District

17. Kanowit Zone: Kanowit District

18. Selangau Zone: Selangau District

19. Kapit Zone: Kapit District

20. Song Zone: Song District

21. Belaga Zone: Belaga District

22. Bukit Mabong Zone: Bukit Mabong District".

Amendment of Second Schedule

3. The Second Schedule to the principal Regulations is amended by substituting for

paragraph 4 the following paragraph:

"4. Entertainment activities at karaoke centers, family entertainment centers,

hotel lounges, cinemas not including drive-in cinemas, and children's

playground in shopping malls".

Made 24 May 2021

[KKM.600-29/4/146 Jld.2 (30); PN(PU2)470/Jld. 6]

DATO' SRI DR. ADHAM BIN BABA

Minister of Health
